test_title: PYST 07: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in the correct order.

Postcolonial literature

P. interrogates historical narratives,

Q. While reclaiming suppressed voices

R. and offers alternative perspectives

S. rooted in indigenous experience,
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. **PSRQ**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with part **P**, "interrogates historical narratives," as it introduces the main theme of postcolonial literature.
 
• Part **S**, "rooted in indigenous experience," comes next, providing context about the foundation of the historical narratives.
 
• Part **R**, "and offers alternative perspectives," logically continues the sentence by explaining the purpose of interrogating narratives.
 
• Finally, part **Q**, "while reclaiming suppressed voices," concludes the sentence, emphasizing the ultimate goal of postcolonial literature.

Therefore, the correct arrangement is **PSRQ.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (RSPQ):** This arrangement disrupts the logical sequence by starting with alternative perspectives without first introducing the historical narratives being interrogated.
 
• **Option 3 (QRSP):** Starting with "while reclaiming suppressed voices" makes the sentence lose its focus on interrogating historical narratives, which is central to postcolonial literature.
 
• **Option 4 (SRPQ):** This arrangement creates a fragmented and unclear sentence structure by starting with indigenous experience without providing context.
